body.objective: Produce a focused, referee-readable main paper whose central theorem is that ordinary one-ended Lorentzian Schwarzschild endpoint conditions do not select the Einstein sector of pure Weyl gravity, incorporating the certified populated Krein channels and intrinsic connection-level QNM exceptional point.
body.stop_condition: Create a self-contained main-paper source and PDF of approximately 25-35 pages with five front-door theorem statements, a controlled vocabulary, one exact-sequence/scattering diagram, and one evidence-state table. Import the exact Ricci-Bach composition, axial RW/RW/spin-one filtration, action-derived endpoint Grams, all-positive-real incoming population, certified outgoing cell and generic outgoing completeness, no-growing separated-mode theorem, polar local endpoint reach, and the certified full connection Smith valuations (0,0,2) by exact content hashes. Move static thermodynamics, horizon-monodromy material, the extended projective-cocycle/QNM development, and panel-by-panel computational chronology out of the main narrative into named companion-paper source stubs or a computational supplement. Preserve every claim boundary, regenerate the claim map, run an independent verifier and mutation tests, and leave a receipt and human report.
body.current_gate: Focused manuscript split and import of the completed Phase-3 scattering and QNM authorities without widening either to a full Tplus-band, Green-resolvent, time-domain or quantum theorem
body.forbid: no authorship or byline work; no static thermodynamics in the focused main narrative; no computational chronology in the main narrative; no connection-level EP2 called a Green-resolvent double pole; no generic outgoing population called all-frequency outgoing invertibility; no reduced-mode or finite-band statement promoted to a complete asymptotically flat phase space, time-domain stability, particle, ghost, CPT or quantum-unitarity theorem; no literature priority claim without a checked source
activates: a journal-length main-paper freeze after either the explicit Tplus-band experiment or the Fredholm EP2 promotion lands
separate mathematical-structure and static-sector companion manuscripts
body.resource_hint: Use Paper 14 as the source archive, not as a second claims authority. The focused paper should lead with the populated indefinite incoming theorem, then the action-derived Krein anatomy, generic outgoing completeness, no-growing result and certified connection EP2. The explicit Tplus-band and analytic Fredholm experiments remain separately gated Phase-4 inputs.
notes: Mathematical target: a minimal theorem chain from the Bach exact sequence to populated Lorentzian endpoint Krein spaces.
